title: Vercel CI is now in beta
description: You can now run CI for your Turborepo with one line of configuration. In Vercel's internal repositories, our wait time from git push to "CI passed" is 2-6x shorter, dramatically improving our CI's ability to keep up with our coding agents. To get started, prompt your agent in your repo: Each task marked with a ci tag runs on every push. Vercel CI automatically takes care of: Only running CI that is affected by your code changes Task caching with Vercel Remote Cache Installing dependencies once per run Caching dependencies across code updates To learn more: Check out our blog post Visit the documentation Discuss Vercel CI on the Community announcement Read more

title: Box Mount now runs in Vercel Sandbox
description: Box Mount lets agents running in Vercel Sandbox read and write Box files through standard filesystem operations. It syncs a Box folder with a directory inside the sandbox. Unmount before you stop the sandbox, and everything the agent wrote is in Box after the sandbox is deleted. The contract-review example uses AI Gateway to review a synthetic contract in Vercel Sandbox and save the review back to Box. The sync process and agent run as separate sandbox users, keeping the Box credentials separate from the agent's workspace. Box Mount is in private preview. Request access from Box, then follow the Box Mount documentation to set it up in Vercel Sandbox. Read more
